preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(T, int) and T >= 1 and T <= 10**5 for T in [int(stdin.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10^5) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == 2 * int(N) and all(c in {'0', '1'} for c in S) for N, S in (stdin.split()[1:], stdin.split()[2:]) if N and S)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line is an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5), and the second line is a binary string S of length 2*N.

postconditions.expression: all((len(stdout_lines) == T) and (len(stdout_line.strip().split()) == N or stdout_line.strip() == '-1') for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either a space-separated list of N distinct indices (1-based) in increasing order or '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all((set(A) == set(range(1, 2*N + 1)) - set(Q)) and len(P) == N and len(Q) == N and P != Q for N, S, A in zip(N_list, S_list, [list(map(int, line.strip().split())) if line.strip() != '-1' else [] for line in stdout.splitlines()]) if A) and (P := [S[i-1] for i in A], Q := [S[i-1] for i in range(1, 2*N + 1) if i not in A]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', then the indices A form a valid partition of S into subsequences P and Q of length N each, where P and Q are not equal. The indices are 1-based and in increasing order.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '-1') or (set(A) == set(range(1, 2*N + 1)) - set(Q)) for N, S, A in zip(N_list, S_list, [list(map(int, line.strip().split())) if line.strip() != '-1' else [] for line in stdout.splitlines()]) if A) and (P := [S[i-1] for i in A], Q := [S[i-1] for i in range(1, 2*N + 1) if i not in A]))
postconditions.description: If the output is '-1', then no valid partition exists for the given S.
